_comment: plan3d fixture: the bundled demo carry-on plus three nested placements, because no producer
in the tree emits `nestedIn` yet (server/app_plan.py writes null for every placement) and the
renderer's nesting path has to be exercised against something. All values in METRES; position
is the MIN CORNER. Copied from packing-core/Sources/PackingPlan/Resources/plan.json, which is
packing-core's file and not this tool's - hence a copy rather than an edit.
Three nests, one per branch of the contract in packing-core/CLAUDE.md:
socks-pair     -> shoes-pair, box fully inside the declared cavity. The legitimate case: the
two boxes intersect, geometryIssues() calls that an overlap, the cavity is
what says it is a nest.
charger-pouch  -> toiletry-kit, box pokes 1 cm out of the cavity on +X while still inside the
host. Contract: overlap outside the cavity cell is still an overlap, so this
has to render as a violation and not be waved through.
passport-pouch -> ghost-liner, an itemId no placement defines. Contract: treated as not
nested, and the dangling id raises its own issue rather than being ignored.

placements.label: Running shoes
placements.note: Soles down, side by side, pushed flush into the end corner. Stuff socks inside.

placements.label: Toiletry kit
placements.note: Stood on end beside the shoes, zip facing up.

placements.label: Folded jeans
placements.note: Flat across the full width, starting just past the shoes.

placements.label: Rolled sweater
placements.note: Rolled along the width and pressed into the far end of the base layer.

placements.label: Stack of shirts
placements.note: Second layer, resting on the jeans with the folded edges outward.

placements.label: Laptop sleeve
placements.note: Flat on top of the shirt stack, last in so it comes out first at security.

placements.label: Socks
placements.note: Balled up and pushed into the shoes.

placements.label: Charger pouch
placements.note: Dropped into the toiletry kit - and 1 cm wider than the cell says.

placements.label: Passport pouch
placements.note: Flat on the laptop sleeve; its nestedIn names an item that is not here.
